input:
The number of discontinuities of the greatest integer function f(x) = [x], x in (-7/2, 100) is

Options:
A. 104
B. 100
C. 102
D. 103

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Count jump discontinuities of floor function in the given open interval.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: [x] is discontinuous at every integer point.

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Convert interval bounds and count all integers strictly inside.
logical_steps: Step 2: List integer range inside interval

phase_5_verify_answer.verification: Each of these 103 integers gives one jump discontinuity of [x].
